Name: Excalibur - The Sword of Legend
Author: AirynS
Description:
Amongst the mysteries still undiscovered in the secret woods lies the great Excalibur, awaiting your arrival. Will you prove that you're worthy of its strength?

This mod adds a new special item and event in the secret woods: a pedestal that holds the sword from the legend, Excalibur. By following the call from the engraving on the stone, you will find the path to wield what was once impossible.

[size=5][b]INSTALLATION[/b][/size]
To install, simply extract the "Excalibur" folder and drop it into your Mods folder. Excalibur only requires Content Patcher, but a small extra feature will be present if you also have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27100]Button's Extra Trigger Action Stuff (BETAS)[/url] installed.

[size=5][b]CONFIGURATION[/b][/size]
To ensure that the stone pedestal's position doesn't collide with other mods that affect the secret woods such as SVE, Excalibur has two connected config options: "Sword X Co-ordinates" and "Sword Y Co-ordinates". These will move the pedestal's position - to use it, find your preferred position in the woods, type "debug ppp" in the SMAPI window to get your current co-ordinates, and then use each of the co-ordinates minus 1 (ie. if the co-ordinate is 25, 13, then you should use 24, 12).

We will not provide specific compatibility with SVE beyond these config options.

[b][size=5]TRANSLATIONS[/size][/b]
You may translate this mod as long as only the translated i18n file is uploaded and AI is not used in the translation process.

[size=5][b]CREDITS[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]This mod was created by Tai and Airyn for the GG Mods Spring Modathon! Tai created the artwork while Airyn did the coding & event.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=5][b]SPOILERS[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Clicking on Excalibur's pedestal will give a hint as to what is needed to obtain the sword and you will most likely unlock it via regular gameplay. If you want to know early what the unlock requirements are, click the following spoiler:[/color]
[spoiler][color=#D4D4D8]Unlocking Excalibur requires Combat level 10 and at least 8 hearts with all vanilla villagers.[/color][/spoiler]
[color=#D4D4D8]It is intended to be a late-game weapon and is appropriately powerful. If you feel it is overpowered, feel free to make a personal edit to your own copy of the mod changing the stats.[/color]
